summary: Apply throughput, target-cost and divisional analysis to complex decisions. Review the five-day advanced managerial accounting course.
lede: Advanced managerial accounting uses internal cost and performance data to guide operational and resource decisions. For intermediate management accountants, controllers and operations finance analysts, the work involves evaluating capacity constraints, product economics and divisional choices beyond routine budgets and variance reports. Practise separating relevant from sunk costs, calculating throughput and target-cost gaps, comparing transfer-pricing options, and explaining customer contribution through concise decision briefs.
audienceIntro: This course suits intermediate practitioners who already work with cost data and need to strengthen analysis beyond routine budgeting and variance reporting.
prerequisites: Working knowledge of cost classification, contribution analysis, budgeting and basic variance reporting. No programming experience is required.
